ib.text: Full IB Diploma accepted; no points floor published. School officials may send predicted grades, followed by final scores. English testing is waived after three years with English as the sole language of instruction.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics and computing for analysing large datasets, with concentrations ranging from finance and AI to genomics.
programmes.overview: Students build foundations in programming, probability, statistics, calculus, linear algebra and algorithms before studying machine learning, database systems and the analysis of diverse kinds of data. The curriculum allows a concentration such as artificial intelligence, finance, genomics, economics or psychology, while maintaining the university-wide liberal arts core. Work culminates in an advanced project or senior capstone linking methods to a problem in a chosen field. The bulletin describes preparation for data-focused roles or further study across technical and other disciplines.
programmes.ib: Campus-wide first-year admission; no separate IB subject or score threshold for this major was located. Chinese-language study is part of the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic campus admission based on academic preparation, application essays, recommendations and school context; major declaration comes later.

programmes.name: Neural Science
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary investigation of the brain, from nerve cells and circuits to cognition and behaviour, using experimental and computational approaches.
programmes.overview: Students begin with foundations in biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics before moving into advanced neural science. The field is approached through molecular and cellular mechanisms, neural circuits, behaviour, cognition and mathematical or computational models of brain function. Required courses and electives culminate in a capstone, allowing students to connect evidence and methods across levels of analysis. The programme also describes a research-oriented honours pathway for eligible students, separate from initial undergraduate admission.
